basePrompts.prompt: Prepare the five APPROVED monster identities from the TOP ROW of the reference sheet as clean production starting sprites. Preserve the exact approved silhouettes, weapons, cream/gold/navy chunky pixel style and recognizable faces. This is extraction/redrawing to isolated starting poses, NOT a redesign. Remove all numbers, all lettering, the entire lower action row, and all background. Genuinely transparent canvas. Output a wide 1536x512 strip of EXACTLY FIVE evenly spaced isolated full-body sprites in one row, one per equal-width cell, all facing LEFT toward the player. Every weapon tip, foot, tail, and suspension chain fits inside its own cell with 24px transparent clearance; no inter-cell overlap. All soles/end of hovering robes share the same baseline around y=450. Each body uses large flat cream-lit planes, gold blocks and dark navy shadows, deliberate chunky square pixel edges, NO added surface detail, gradients, glows or shadows outside the silhouette. The largest enemy remains the final column. Give each figure a simple neutral ready stance appropriate for animating. Left to right: empty spear gate sentry; bell-clapper mechanical hound; cracked sword knight; squat barricade crossbar golem; tall bell-crowned gate guardian with barred shield and halberd. Preserve the marked height/shape differences.
